sloka: तत्र तां च शुभाचारामाश्रमान्ते यशस्विनीम् ।पुनरप्यागतो वीर पादमूलमुपासितुम् ।। ७.५२.९ ॥
transliteration: tatra tāṁ ca śubhācārāmāśramānte yaśasvinīm ।punarapyāgato vīra pādamūlamupāsitum ।। 7.52.9 ॥

translations.english: O hero, I have returned to serve at your feet, having left her, who is of auspicious conduct and glorious, there at the edge of the hermitage.
